{{Top|leg}}
'''Blindness''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Ascendants using this spell could eliminate a target's sense of sight, leaving them able to see nothing more than a gray blur. Proficient and skilled wielders could use the spell to blind multiple targets.<ref name="Endgame">''[[Endgame]]''</ref>
